annotations.title: Web page image SEO & performance audit

description: Web page image SEO & performance audit — Audit every image tag on a public page: missing or filename-like alt text, decorative empty alts, missing width/height (layout shift), lazy-loading below the fold and wrongly lazy hero images, legacy JPG/PNG/GIF without WebP/AVIF, srcset usage, duplicates, og:image. Returns score/grade, counts, recommendations and the image list. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
